summary: Candidate is a distinct session_skill in performance_diagnostics (comparative_measurement method) that bridges field data (CrUX) and lab data (Lighthouse) to classify CLS source. It is semantically different from peer candidates: 'Locate Layout Shift Elements' focuses on DevTools instrumentation/inspection of load-phase shifts; 'Validate User Flows' is regression testing via Lighthouse timespans; 'Collect Field CLS Attribution' is RUM instrumentation for production data. The candidate performs diagnostic triage (field vs. lab comparison) that precedes and informs which of those peer skills to apply next. Existing skills are unrelated (Flink streaming, database benchmarking). No merge, split, or revision applies.
